cross_provider: Metrica Game 3, one previously viewed development game; never independent final test

label_policy.primary: strict y_alive/y_home masks with source semantics; unknown is excluded only from frame scoring
label_policy.skillcorner_dead: not_established; phase complement only a separately named proxy sensitivity
label_policy.metrica_dead: partial event proxy, not independently adjudicated continuous GT
label_policy.full_spell: null unless independently verified complete HAD annotation covers every frame of each declared period
label_policy.censored_spell: diagnostic only, never ranks or promotes models
label_policy.decoder_boundaries: metadata periods only, independent of labels

experiments.E0: No training: compare historical fixed-50 reference and period-scoped 2-second reference; audit label coverage, censored spells, fps and duration
experiments.E1: Replay fixed observed baseline once; fix Home probabilities, compare raw weighted Alive, analytical prior correction, and logistic calibration on separate calibration match; all Alive results explicitly proxy-only
experiments.E2: Fix baseline Alive and visible-ball Home; train one missing-ball Home expert on natural missing and already input-masked/recomputed dropout caches; gate only on ball visibility; no new features or grid search
experiments.E3: Fix both baseline probabilities; compare original per-frame Viterbi with fps-normalized transition costs. Report argmax/decoder error attribution and censored boundary support. No event/HSMM training without trustworthy boundary evidence

uncertainty: paired bootstrap over four SkillCorner heldout matches, 2000 draws, seed 2027; no frame-IID or repeated-Metrica bootstrap
retention_rule: Missing expert remains experimental only if natural-missing Brier improves in >=3 of 4 matches, paired mean Brier delta CI upper<0, visible predictions unchanged and no >0.01 drop in per-match primary partial macro F1; otherwise revert to observed baseline. Timing fixes are engineering correctness, not evidence of model superiority.
promotion: No automatic promotion: independent complete HAD + credible dead labels + fresh holdout + team approval remain required
historical_results: v2 reports immutable; all four matches and Metrica already development data
budget: Replay eight baseline heads; four missing experts; no hyperparameter search or new large downloads
